Service terms

Clear information about this website and the proposed service.

Draft service information. The full agreement must be confirmed before packages are offered for purchase.

Confirmed approach

Prices are quoted excluding VAT. TradeBuilt offers no fixed contracts and customers can cancel anytime. Package names, prices and inclusions currently displayed are illustrative placeholders.

Payment and cancellation

Monthly payments are intended to use Stripe Bacs Direct Debit. This integration is not active. Billing dates, cancellation handling, annual payment refunds and any outstanding charges must be agreed before purchase.

Scope and ownership

The final agreement must define deliverables, support allowances, domain and website ownership, licences, hosting arrangements after cancellation, approval responsibilities and any exclusions. Do not rely on the draft package examples as final contractual terms.
